name: Calendar
description: The person's calendar: record writes a to-do or a memory on a day, at a time or for a span. It shows as a time axis: one day in the task page's side panel, a week in a full tab.
subtitle: Calendar, to-dos and notes
author: 咕咕

zh-CN.name: 日历
zh-CN.description: 按时间轴看的日历：侧栏里是一天，整页是一周；待办和记事按钟点排开，没写时间的放在「全天」。你自己记，或者让 agent 帮你记。
zh-CN.subtitle: 时间轴上的待办与记事

en.name: Calendar
en.description: A calendar on a time axis: one day in the side panel, a week in a full tab; to-dos and memories at their hour, untimed ones in the all-day row, written by you or by an agent.
en.subtitle: To-dos and notes by the hour
